messages:
Alex: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we unbundle the request serializer/enricher path from the runtime hotpath into a 'request-slab' service. This would let runtime focus on hot token generation and keep per-tenant transforms versioned independently.

Marta: +1 on isolation. concern: KV cache locality. if we move prefix transforms out, will we lose cache hits?

Nikhil: Good Q. Plan is to keep KV cache in runtime; adapter emits canonicalized requests (same prefix) so cache keys unchanged. We need strict canonicalization test.

Jamie: How about latency? extra hop adds ~1ms maybe, but batching could amortize. Do we have numbers?

Alex: did a quick spike: local loopback adds ~0.8ms median, 2.5ms p99 on dev with debug flags. On GPU hosts larger impact but we can colocate adapters.

Marta: Can we run as sidecar first? minimizes network hop and easier rollback.

Nikhil: +1 sidecar for canary. then optional standalone pool for tenant-shared workloads.

design-bot: Deploy checklist created: https://go.internal/checklists/serializer-unbundle — created by design-bot

Jamie: ops questions: rollout gating? propose: 1) static feature flag + dark traffic, 2) canary 1% -> 50% -> 100%, 3) revert plan to route-back.

Alex: Agree. Need telemetry: per-request canonicalization hash, cache-hit ratio pre/post, CPU on runtime.

Marta: Tests: add golden canonicalization vectors and end-to-end regression evals. I'll own test harness.

Nikhil: Also add batching regression — ensure continuous batcher still merges requests when adapter present.

Jamie: Add oncall runbook lines: how to detect increased p99 or cache drop, and how to flip routing.

Alex: quick envoy route snippet for canary:
```
- match: { header: { name: "x-unbundle-canary", exact: "true" } }
  route: { cluster: serializer-slab-canary }
```

Marta: smoke test command:
```
curl -H "x-unbundle-canary: true" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' http://localhost:8080/generate
```

Jamie: timeline? propose 3 sprints: spike + sidecar, canary + metrics, rollout + tidy.

Alex: I'll write a short RFC doc and link. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Marta: lgtm :shipit:
